paragraphs: Hyman says this is how Rabbah bar Bar Chana is consistently named in the Jerusalem Talmud: his name was Abba, as explicitly stated, he says, in Bava Batra 75a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The repeated Abba naming and the Bava Batra proof are Hyman’s claims, not results of a new whole-corpus count.

The complete Davidson Bava Batra 75a page, eighteen whole paragraphs, is a bounded nonmatch for Hyman’s proof that the name was Abba. His consistently-in-the-Jerusalem-Talmud claim and cited proof remain his historical assertions, and the current note stays verbatim; no whole-corpus count, alternative locator repair, or Abba/Rabbah identity binding is made.
